newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures called to open steady.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures called to open steady.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged as of 1023 EDT, floor sources said.
Flour sources cited a quiet market, with traders waiting for the Aug 12 crop report and Thursday's weekly export sales.
Also, one trader said there were good chances of rain in west Texas.
Tuesday, Memphis-based Dunavant Enterprises has estimated the 1997/98 U.S. cotton crop to total 17.9 million (480-lb) bales, chief executive officer and chairman Billy Dunavant said.
USDA in July projected the 1997/98 (Aug 1-July 31) crop at 18 million bales.
